0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6, 2-3 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak) in Miami's 10th game of the season, with the Heat 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and 9th in the East. Sacramento is 15th in the West and 6.5 games back in the Pacific, and it will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while De'Andre Hunter is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Heat's most recent win in the series was a 130-117 victory in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
